solo.goal: Start with briefs, service delivery, invoices and client reporting without a technical team
solo.connection_priority: Enabled marketplace apps, then official MCP, then reviewed aggregator, then local files

reporting: Google Ads and GA4 official query MCP

optional: Xero official MCP or existing accountant/ledger exports
Composio for a missing reviewed business connector
solo.approval: The human business owner approves agent-prepared actions. Never equate the AI maker with the human approver. Follow documented independent review rules for owner expenses/beneficiary changes.
solo.default_mode: Drafts and read-only reports until connectors and host controls are verified

studio.goal: Manage creative production and project margin

accounting: QuickBooks via reviewed Composio tools or official API adapter

studio.default_mode: No publishing, invoice issuance or payment without exact action approval

performance.goal: Run measurable advertising with controlled budgets and financial reconciliation

ad_execution: official API adapter with reviewed MCP boundary

performance.default_mode: Read-only discovery first; bounded approved writes after runtime enforcement
